title: A separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most one has an ample invertible sheaf
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] whose structure morphism is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with topological Krull dimension $\dim X\leq1$ [def-pc-dimension]. Then there exists an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module] which is ample in the absolute sense of Stacks Definition 01PS [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module].
